setup.text: A nearly vanished vine yields a dye that never fades, making it prized by weavers.

text_only.reason: a plant nearly vanished; no villager vanishes

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The weavers produce a brilliant cloth, but the vine recovers slowly.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The harvest proves too much, and the village suspends gathering.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The colors fade sooner, but the rare vine remains untouched.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The substitute stains unevenly, disappointing a craftsperson.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Several cuttings root, offering hope for future dye.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The cuttings fail, reminding the village that rarity cannot be hurried.
